item.text: Play last used songlist after starting
item.description: Resume the saved playlist when opening the player.
Press OK to choose the music folder.
Show embedded artwork, images in the music folder and downloaded album covers.
Search MusicBrainz and the Cover Art Archive using artist and album tags. Music files are never modified.
Downloaded covers are stored here and remain available after a reboot.
Look up missing lyrics on LRCLIB using artist, title, album and duration. Results are cached in the music database folder; music files are not changed.
Press OK to select a writable folder for the music database.
